name: Kissing Before Marriage
overview: Scripture emphasizes the sanctity of relationships and the importance of purity before marriage, as seen in Job's commitment to guard his eyes from lust (Job 31:1) and Jesus' teaching that even looking with lust is adultery in the heart (Matthew 5:28). The union of marriage is described as a sacred joining where two become one flesh, to be honored and not separated (Matthew 19:6). While expressions of love have their proper time (Ecclesiastes 3:8), the Bible encourages delighting in God's law and meditating on it continually (Psalms 1:2), guiding believers to honor God's design in relationships. The narrative of Jacob and Rachel (Genesis 29:10) illustrates a respectful approach to courtship, underscoring the value of patience and integrity in developing romantic bonds.
